panels: (a) top: number of degenerate orbital shells for the ten benchmark molecules in STO-3G, against the outcome reported in the literature
(b) bottom: filtered error measured in independent processes, one point per replicate, grouped by the BLAS thread count of the process

elements.encodes: molecules the audited work reports as failing
the predictor threshold: two or more degenerate shells predicts failure
how many of the scored molecules the predictor gets right
elements.visual: left-aligned 7 pt text above the axes

elements.encodes: filtered error of one independent process; horizontal jitter is cosmetic
elements.visual: bluish green #009E73 circles, alpha 0.75, size 30. Panel (b) deliberately uses colours panel (a) does not, so no colour reading carries between panels

elements.encodes: two coinciding quantities: the cost of the same filter when the irrep labels come from the calculation that defines the Hamiltonian, measured in the companion experiment E1, and the mean unfiltered UCCSD error over these replicates, which is the rotation-invariant control. They agree to three decimals because the filter is free when the labels are correct, so one line carries both and its label prints both numbers
elements.visual: dotted in the molecule's panel-(b) colour, 1.1 pt, labelled at left in 7 pt; the CH4 label sits above its line and the NH3 label below, because at 7 pt the two lines are one line of text apart

axes.x: (a) molecule, none; (b) BLAS thread count of the replicate process
axes.y: (a) count of degenerate orbital shells; (b) filtered error in mHa

params.replicates_per_thread_count: 10, except NH3 at one thread which has 20

reference_lines: filter cost with correct labels per molecule in (b) (dotted)
unfiltered UCCSD error per molecule, coinciding with the line above
artifact_predictor_and_spread.normalization: none; absolute counts and absolute mHa
